ja211:1.1: You practiced, and were constantly heedful,
ja211:1.2: For a year, in the fragrant grass bushes.
ja211:1.3: You changed the meaning in the assembly,
ja211:1.4: The one of little wisdom did not preserve the sense.
ja211:2.1: The one who begs, dear Somadatta, undergoes (one of) two things:
ja211:2.3: He receives wealth or doesn’t receive,
ja211:2.4: this is the nature of asking.
